mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing future stock price expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite rising FEDFUNDS, or the discount rate effect is offset by other factors (e.g., strong corporate earnings growth).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 above 23,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding the threshold, or the effect is reversed in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO above 103.1168 (as of t-2mo) indicates strengthening supply-side conditions, enhancing production capacity and corporate profitability, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise above baseline levels during the INDPRO expansion, or the effect diminishes in the face of external shocks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.0% signals improving labor market conditions, reducing unemployment pressure and boosting consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0%, or the effect is reversed in a weakening economy.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 indicates converging monetary and demand expansion pressures, amplifying discount rate impacts on equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise simultaneously, or the interaction effect is diluted by market volatility over the longer horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly drop in UNRATE below 4.0% during a late-cycle expansion regime signals labor market softening, reducing upward wage pressures and boosting investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in the late-cycle regime, or the effect is reversed due to external factors.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in both GDPC1 and INDPRO together indicates robust demand and supply expansion, synergistically strengthening corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise significantly when both proxies move upward simultaneously, or the interaction effect is diluted by market volatility over the shorter horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in both UNRATE and PAYEMS above their recent trends signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and reducing consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite rising UNRATE and PAYEMS, or the effect is reversed in a broader economic downturn.
